/// <summary>Distinguishes an omitted JSON property from a present value, including null.</summary>
[global::System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter(typeof(OptionalConverterFactory))]
public readonly struct Optional<T>
{
    private readonly T _value;
    /// <summary>Whether this property was explicitly assigned or present in JSON.</summary>
    public bool IsDefined { get; }
    /// <summary>The present value. Throws when this property is omitted.</summary>
    public T Value => IsDefined ? _value : throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("The property is omitted.");
    /// <summary>Creates a present value, including explicit null for nullable types.</summary>
    public Optional(T value) { _value = value; IsDefined = true; }
    public static implicit operator Optional<T>(T value) => new(value);
}
